system.description:
You generate a large quantity of smoke in your hand and throw it at point within 60 feet, generating a 15-foot radius, cloud of smoke, centered on the point. Each creature within the affected area must make a Dexterity saving throw, taking 3d8 Fire damage and falling prone on a failed save, or half as much damage and no further effects.

The smoke created by this jutsu persists for 1 minute, causing creatures within to become heavily obscured for as long as they still within, though you can see through the smoke just fine. Creatures that end their turns within this smoke cloud, take 1d8 poison damage.

At Higher Ranks: For each rank you cast this jutsu above D-Rank, increase the cost of this jutsu by 3 and the damage by 1d8. If cast to B-Rank or higher, you can disperse the leftover smoke as a free action on your turn, otherwise, the smoke now lasts 10 minutes.
